advisory.finding: The read_file truncated-cache past-window fallback path reports executed work via ledger.record_executed (diff line ~248), but no test exercises that branch inside a loop against the runaway guard. test_read_file_truncated_file_falls_back_to_exact_read_beyond_window runs a single 2-call landing sequence and asserts only slice content and execution count, so removing the record_executed on the fallback branch (the executed-work report) would not fail any test even though it would make the guard's ratio arm blind to a loop of genuine past-window fallback re-reads.

blocking.finding: bugfix-size-attestation: this change touches 217 non-test line(s) — over the 150-line floor for a bug fix — but bug 3211-be4f-d4aa-4b5c has no acceptable plan-review attestation (verdict: unsigned; no plan-review attestation record). A fix this large is a design change wearing a bug label: write the fix plan into the ticket's description, run `rebar review-plan 3211-be4f-d4aa-4b5c` (it auto-escalates a bug with non-test file impact to the full review and SIGNS an attestation on a PASS; if the review passed but no attestation landed, `rebar sign-review 3211-be4f-d4aa-4b5c` re-persists it cheaply, and `rebar review-plan 3211-be4f-d4aa-4b5c --status` confirms it is current without an LLM call), then re-push.

dropped.finding: The new test names its stub tool 'record_criterion_verdict' — the exact RECORD_CRITERION_VERDICT_TOOL name governed by the completion-evidence policy. The test asserts the loop trips the executed-work ratio arm, but if a completion policy were active for this run, repeated record calls sharing a run_step would be answered with COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE (served, not executed via memo.record_executed), so the streak backstop — not the ratio arm — could fire, and the 'executed tool calls' assertion would fail. The test relies on the (implicit, unstated) fact that this text-mode/no-reviewers path yields completion_policy=None.
